caseData.headline: Likely: money from lenders or linked companies is arriving dressed up as customer payments

findings.plain: money from lenders or linked companies is arriving dressed up as customer payments
invoices are fake, inflated or altered
the borrower has debt it has not disclosed
the borrower is connected to undisclosed shell companies
the reported financial statements don't fit the evidence

signals.explanation: 72 invoice numbers were submitted more than once with different amounts (up to 24.8x the original)
'Sterling Capital Partners LLC' holds a lien on a related company ('Sterling Customer Collections LLC': all accounts receivable) that the borrower never disclosed
Reported receivables are 17.1x their usual size relative to revenue (2 quarters in a row): money is booked that isn't being collected
$13,740,260 (8.3% of inflows) arrived as 'customer' cash from 'Sterling Customer Collections LLC', an undisclosed company linked to the borrower
8 of 15 invoice documents show a different total from the borrower's data (read twice by the document model)
Setpoint PledgeCheck: actual collections don't match what the borrower reported
Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 1 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings
Reported revenue is running 26% above what verified customer cash supports (2 quarters in a row)
'Sterling Customer Collections LLC' looks like a shell: no operations, same address as borrower, no LEI / not in GLEIF
'Sterling Customer Collections II LLC' looks like a shell: no operations, same address as borrower, no LEI / not in GLEIF
'Sterling Services LLC' looks like a shell: same address as borrower, formed 9 months ago, no LEI / not in GLEIF
106 invoices are over 5x what the named customer normally pays
15.3% of invoices past due were never paid by the named customer (142 of 931)
Reported receivables include invoices that S4 found altered, unpaid or implausible
Undisclosed related company 'Sterling Customer Collections LLC' shares the borrower's officer and address and phone number
Undisclosed related company 'Sterling Trade Services LLC' shares the borrower's officer
Undisclosed related company 'Sterling Customer Collections II LLC' shares the borrower's officer and address
